issues: Radix DialogContent missing aria-describedby / Description — accessibility warning in console (non-blocking)

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1639 lines — iteration 3 carry-over. Strongly recommend splitting into routes/* and services/* modules before next iteration (checkout, chain, reports, api_v1, auth).
GET /api/orders/{order_no}/public auto-expires on read via a write (update_one). This is OK but means an unauthenticated GET can mutate state; low risk but worth noting.

verify_api_request records audit for api.ip_rejected before signature verification — so an unverified caller with a known api_key can spam audit_logs. Consider verifying signature first (or rate-limiting unverified rejections).

sign_payload still filters empty/None fields in both verification and preview (as in iteration 2 note); server + sample stay consistent. The iteration-2 'sign-preview' concern about empty-field divergence between sign_string and sign_payload remains unverified but did not surface in iteration-4 tests.
list_address_health performs 3 full aggregations on every call (no caching); for 10+ addresses it's fine, but under heavier load add a short-lived cache or project only needed fields.
agent_commission_report loads up to 100000 orders in-memory for a month — ok for current volumes; for growth switch to Mongo aggregation + streaming write to xlsx.

update_my_ip_whitelist uses raw string IP comparison in verify_api_request; client_ip takes first X-Forwarded-For — fine, but spec of multi-IP XFF chains (proxy of proxy) could cause mismatches. Document that caller must whitelist their egress IP as seen by Kubernetes ingress.
DialogContent lacks DialogDescription (shadcn), causing React a11y warnings in console for both checkout-settings-dialog and commission-export-dialog.
